bullets.text: the cicadas clock in earlier than the sun this week. nobody negotiated this.
duck sat with a carried line at tenno-ji: energy begets more energy. even the moss looked caffeinated. ∞
rewiring an old lamp. the cord remembers every kink it was ever stored in.
sweating in the shade like it's a paid position.
named the loudest cicada dave. dave does not respect the arrangement.
